full_judgment: 4. Mr. Md. Omar Ali Khan, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the learned Senior Assistant Judge committed an error of law in rejecting the application under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code with the findings that the petitioners did not prove that the summons were not served upon them and thereby shifted burden of proof on the petitioners from the opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 and thus committed an error of law which has resulted in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. He then submits that the learned Senior Assistant Judge committed an error of law by misconstruing and misinterpreting the law and facts of the case and material evidence on record and came to an erroneous decision which has resulted in an error in decision occasioning failure of justice. He finally submits that the impugned judgment and order suffers from contradictory findings and the learned Senior Assistant Judge committed an error of law in passing the impugned judgment and order which has occasioned failure of justice and as such the Rule should be made absolute.
